name: Dark Chants shortens Forbidden Ritual's cast time and raises Black Blood's stack cap (#3163)
contract: Dark Chants 712471 (Spell.dbc, passive, family 31) has two effects, both APPLY_AURA, both spellmods: effect0 is SPELLMOD_FLAT (aura 107) on SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (misc 10), EffectBasePoints -1001 + DieSides(1)-derived +1 = -1000 ms, class mask dword C bit18 (262144), which is exactly the SpellFamilyFlags of both 'Forbidden Ritual' records (800105, 802766). effect1 is SPELLMOD_FLAT on SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS (misc 31, an Ascension-native spellmod op), BasePoints 0+1=+1, class mask dword B bit15 (32768), exactly the SpellFamilyFlags of both 'Black Blood' records (804113, 804153), whose own StackAmount is natively 1. Both spellmods are read generically: SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME by SpellInfo::CalcCastTime -> Unit::ModSpellCastTime, and SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS by SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks (SpellInfo.cpp ~1442-1465), both called through the ordinary Player::ApplySpellMod path with no CoA script or dummy handler for 712471 anywhere in src/server/coa or src/server/game. The spell_modifier metric (op 10, arbitrary base) proves the flat -1000 ms cast-time mod in isolation; spell_max_stacks proves the native StackAmount(1)+1=2 cap directly, which is the exact mechanism SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks implements. A control spell outside both class masks (Netherstrike 806222, family 31, SpellFamilyFlags dword A bit18 only) must be unaffected by both mods. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively; no code change.
